record.question: An American Indian who was awarded Edgar A.Poe Award in May 2016 was
record.explanation: The Edgar A. Poe Award is given by the White House Correspondents' Association for excellence in presidential news coverage. Neela Banerjee, an Indian-American journalist, was a recipient of this award in 2016 (announced May 2016). The other options are an actress (Sri Devi) and scientists (Ramanujan Hegde, Lakshminarayanan Mahadevan), who would not be eligible for a journalism award.
